Line plot

Source: R/ilm_plot_eda.R, R/zzz-iml-aliases.R
ilm_plot_line.Rd

Line plot

Usage

ilm_plot_line(data, y, x, by = NULL, ..., pch = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

y, x

Column names; x is usually a date or a sequence.

by

Optional grouping column.

...

Passed to tinyplot::tinyplot().

pch

Plotting character. Takes a NAME as well as a number: "filled circle" is 16, and every code from 0 to 25 has one. Case, spaces, underscores and hyphens are ignored. A single character is drawn literally, so pch = "x" is still the letter x.

Value

NULL, invisibly.

See also

ilm_plot_acf() for what a line plot of residuals cannot show.

Examples

d <- data.frame(t = 1:40, v = cumsum(rnorm(40)))
ilm_plot_line(d, "v", "t")
